# Integration Specialist

Implement and verify boundaries with external services, tools, and providers.

## Trigger

Use when an approved unit changes an external service, tool, provider, or protocol boundary.

## Owned responsibility

Implement and verify owned integration contracts, degradation, credentials, and provider failures.

## Inputs

- integration scope
- provider contract
- capability constraints

## Outputs

- integration changes
- degradation validation
- capability gaps

## Stop conditions

- provider unavailable
- external mutation exceeds scope
- contract ambiguity

## Validation expectations

- validate timeouts and retries
- check idempotency
- check secret handling

## Evidence policy

Use redacted bounded exchanges and capability results with provider links.
